description: This PHP class defines a MinutesField used in a cron scheduling system, allowing validation and manipulation of minute values including special characters like '*', '/', and '-'. It extends an abstract class and provides methods for checking satisfaction criteria, incrementing the date, and validating input values.

classes.name: MinutesField
classes.description: Represents a minute component in a cron expression, allowing validation, satisfaction checking, and incrementing of time based on minute values.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the given date's minutes satisfy the specified value or pattern.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments or decrements the given DateTime object by one minute.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that a cron minute value string conforms to the allowed pattern.
